item.title: Former Bodo Sahitya Sabha President Taren Boro Passes Away At 70
item.description: Renowned litterateur Taren Boro breathed his last at around 2:56 pm on Saturday at a private hospital in Guwahati at the age of 70. According to reports, he was suffering from chronic pneumonia and following a sudden deterioration in his health today, he was admitted to the hospital; however, he passed away shortly after. Following his demise, several noted personalities of intellectual and literary background, along with family members and relatives, arrived at the hospital to pay their respect

item.title: Guwahati: 3-Year-Old Abducted from GMCH, CCTV Shows Woman Taking Child
item.description: A three-year-old child was allegedly abducted from the premises of Gauhati Medical College and Hospital (GMCH) in Guwahati, with CCTV footage reportedly capturing a woman taking the child away. The incident, which occurred on Thursday, came to light only on Saturday, raising concerns over security at the hospital. item.title: Assam CM Takes Stock of Cycle Factory, Bharalumukh Flyover Constructions
item.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Saturday inspected the ongoing construction of the Cycle Factory and Bharalumukh flyovers in Guwahati, expressing satisfaction with the pace of work at both sites. He was accompanied by Union Minister Pabitra Margherita during the visit. item.title: ‘Save Land, Save Identity’: Gaurav Gogoi Targets Assam Govt in Lakhimpur Rally
item.description: The streets of Lakhimpur resonated with slogans as the “Samay Parivartanor Yatra” (Journey for Change) led by Assam Pradesh Congress Committee (APCC) president Gaurav Gogoi reached the district on Friday. item.description: In a renewed crackdown against illegalBrick kilns, the district administration on Sunday carried out a demolition drive in Mankachar, destroying five unauthorised units in South Salmara-Mankachar district of Assam. item.title: Assam CM Announces Mega Tunnel and Ring Road Projects for Assam
item.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Sunday announced a series of major infrastructure approvals for the state during a press conference held at Lok Sewa Bhawan in Guwahati, describing the developments as “transformational” for Assam and the wider Northeast. Addressing the media, the Chief Minister said the Government of India has approved several key projects, including the ambitious Guwahati Ring Road and the long-awaited Gohpur–Numaligarh river tunnel across the Brahmaputra.
